meals.title: Braai Boerewors with Pap and Tomato Relish
meals.why: Checkers boerewors is R89.99/kg with Xtra Savings, and a 10kg bag of maize meal makes the pap almost free.
method: Get the coals going. Cook the wors over medium heat for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add the chopped tomatoes and chilli, then simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Bring salted water to the boil and stir in the maize meal. Cover and cook on low for 15-20 minutes, stirring now and then, until crumbly pap forms.
Serve the wors with the pap and tomato relish.

meals.title: Shakshuka Baked Eggs with Panini for Dipping
meals.why: Tinned tomatoes at R14.99, a tray of 18 eggs at the Checkers Xtra Savings price and paprika on special make a cheap vegetarian dinner.
method: Soften the onion and garlic in a wide pan with oil. Stir in the paprika and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened. Season.
Make 4-6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low for 5-7 minutes until the whites are set.
Warm the panini and serve with a spoon of plain yoghurt on top.

meals.title: Quick Mince Sloppy Joes with Carrot Slaw
meals.why: Lean mince is R99.99/kg with Xtra Savings, and PnP hotdog rolls plus tomato sauce turn it into a 25-minute dinner.
method: Brown the mince in a hot pan with the onion and garlic, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the chopped tomatoes and a good squeeze of tomato sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then season.
Grate the carrots and toss with a splash of vinegar, a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar.
Split and warm the rolls, fill with the mince and top with the slaw.

meals.title: Slow-Braised Short Ribs with Potatoes and Carrots
meals.why: Short ribs are the cheaper cut for a slow braise, and the potatoes, carrots and tinned tomatoes are all on special for the pot.
method: Heat the oven to 160°C. Season the ribs and brown them in a heavy ovenproof pot, then set aside.
Fry the onion and garlic in the same pot. Add the chopped tomatoes, a dissolved stock cube in 1 cup of water, and the bay leaves.
Return the ribs, cover and braise for 2 hours.
Add the chunked potatoes and carrots, then cook for another 45-60 minutes until the meat is falling off the bone.
Skim off the fat and serve straight from the pot.

meals.title: Paprika Chicken and Potato Traybake
meals.why: A 5kg frozen braaipack gives several family meals for about R40/kg, so portion it and freeze the rest.
method: Thaw the chicken pieces you need in the fridge the day before, and refreeze the rest in portions.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the chicken with oil, paprika, crushed garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Spread the chopped potatoes and carrots in a roasting tray, then nestle the chicken on top.
Roast for 45-55 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Squeeze lemon over the tray before serving.

meals.title: Pork Braai Chops with Roast Butternut and Cucumber-Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: Pork braai chops are R69.99/kg, butternut is R14.99/kg and it's in season, and the yoghurt and cucumber make a cool side.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss butternut wedges with oil, salt and paprika, then roast for 30-35 minutes.
Season the chops and braai them over medium coals for 5-6 minutes per side. A hot grill pan also works.
Dice the cucumber and mix with the yoghurt, crushed garlic, mint, lemon juice and salt.
Rest the chops for 5 minutes and serve with the butternut and the cucumber-yoghurt salad.
